received_works.body: こんにちは。また申し込みます。あなたの芸術がとても好きです！あなたの作品はとても素晴らしいです。私のVtuber "G_EUL"の外観を描くことはできませんか？名前の由来は「世界に一画を描く人」の韓国語を引用したGEULです。以前の姿とは異なり、新衣装を用意しました。作家様の作品が必要です。ポーズは下作家様の作品のようにもしかして可能でしょうか？私がとても好きな作品ですから。それとも、そのような気がすることを願っています！ （キャンバスサイズはピクセル単位です） - アーティストに適切なコンテンツを配信するために、adobe photoshopにaiの背景を追加しました。 （これ以外の使用はありませんので、ご了承ください）https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RUSD5CLam9zX9YoQwGAYYdxe359qZNPV/view?usp=sharing YouTubeやsns程度の使用です。 - 背景のあるもの - 背景のないもの - 透明化 PNG ダンスが好きで、音楽が大好きです。自動翻訳がうまくなって渡されたらいいですね。いつも応援します。よろしくお願いします。ありがとうございます。

2010年冬を舞台にした絵を描いてください！
リッキー・バーンズ（生年月日：1973/09/27、188cm/95kg）https://skeb.jp/@clashkuroneko/works/102 は、この少年（生年月日：1998/08/21）https://skeb.jp/@naokimineta026/works/262 にナイフファイトのトレーニングをしている！少年は155cmの痩せ型で、普通の眼鏡と短い髪型（この後リッキーの髪型になる）、服は冬物でリンクと同じ配色で描いてください。
リッキーにベレー帽を除いた服を着せ、https://residentevil.fandom.com/wiki/Jack_Krauser?file=Jackkrauser+2.png 、両腕はそのままに描く（2015年に左腕を失う）。若く見えるようにし、このあごひげをつける。https://i.pinimg.com/736x/d2/b1/cb/d2b1cb621c03518db2d9f01491e07b6c.jpg 。
彼らがトレーニングしているナイフは、フェアベアン・サイクスのファイティングナイフです。舞台は少年の屋敷の中にある道場（彼は裕福な家庭の出身で、リッキーは彼と彼の兄弟を訓練するために雇われた。リッキーは少年に他の武器や武術も教えた）。
少年の左耳にある銀のスタッドピアスもお忘れなく！

Long time no see! It's been months since I requested you.

This time, can you draw me two hitmen? They are a concept I have been having since 2011. This will be a bit complicated, so hear me out. Draw them in a shabby, bright looking room with a round brown wooden table.

The first hitman is a man who is 175 cm and 77 kg, so draw him a bit athletic and muscular. His name is Reynold "Reys" Buckham. He has short messy brown hair in a textured fringe with blue eyes that both have amber color in the center (Central heterochromia). He has fair skin. He was born on April 16, 1974, so draw him looking in his late 40s. For his clothes, he wears a blue and yellow flannel shirt, black jeans, brown hiking boots, and an empty holster for his revolver. Draw him holding a Winchester model 70 sniper rifle with a Bushnell scope on his left hand and a snub nosed Taurus Raging Bull on his right hand.

Now the next hitman is going to be a little complicated. I based his appearance on Steven Stone AKA Daigo Tsuwabuki from Pokemon, so you can kind of use him as a reference. His name is Peter Stone, however, his real name is Petar Kamenovic. He is 185 cm tall and 75 kg, so draw him with an average build and slimmer than "Reys." He has messy spiky downward silver blue hair with spiky bangs that is ear length (basically, shonen hair) with an ahoge (idiot hair), silver blue eyes, and pale skin. For his clothes, he wears a dark gray tailcoat with silver cuffs on the end of his sleeves and blue vertical jagged stripes, dark gray slacks with a blue vertical stripe on each side, black dress shoes, a navy vest with gold stripes, and a dress shirt with a purple cravat. He also wears black gloves too, and a gold watch on his left wrist. Draw him holding a black colored 183 cm long Zweihander with the tip of the blade planted on the ground in his left hand while looking at his golden pocket watch with a chain attached to his vest on his right hand. He was born on April 20, 1978, but instead of looking like he is in his mid 40s, draw him with a youthful appearance like he is in his early 20s (He looks young because of his black sword).
